name: dmlab_psychlab_sequential_comparison
title: DMLab psychlab_sequential_comparison

obs.frame: 64x64 first-person view, 90 degree FOV, eye 0.5 cells above the floor

max_steps_source: episodeLengthSeconds 300 s x 60 fps / action repeat 4

human.controls: Click the view to look with the mouse (Esc gives it back), or use the arrow keys. The player cannot walk; you answer by where you look.
human.hint: Click the view to look around with the mouse (Esc gives it back). Look at the red cross to start. Remember the shapes, then look at the small turquoise square and away. When the shapes come back, look at the right button if nothing changed or the left one if a shape changed, then look away to answer.

reference.name: DeepMind Lab (DMLab-30)
reference.parity: G3 (psychlab): under the dumps' gaze-controller actions the view (yaw, pitch) per frame within 1e-3 degrees, the gaze on the screen (DMLab's lookat: a muzzle-point trace) within 1e-4 of the screen, the rewards and the screen's widget changes identical; replay inputs (games/<level>.replay.json): the view accumulators' phases and each trial's end-study spot, study and test arrays and delay
not_matched: pixels: the room is a cube panorama captured from the oracle at the fixed eye (tools/psych_panorama.py); the screen is drawn as solid rects
the corpus is DMLab seeds 0..31; episode seed s plays corpus entry s mod 32
actions: IMPALA's 9 plus look up and look down (IMPALA's set cannot reach the answer buttons)
trials in play: drawn with the port's PCG following the factory's rules (domains, transforms, delays, the staircase over set sizes), not DMLab's Lua RNG
the end-study button: a turquoise square with a black centre; DMLab scales a 25 px bordered image to 24 px
reference.family_pins: manifest.json (oracle, action set, constants, dump hashes, files read)
